headline: Ramayana Day 13: ₹28.35 Cr India nett
lede: Ramayana's Day 13 collection so far, on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, is ₹28.35 Cr India nett and ₹33.85 Cr India gross, -11.4% from Day 12's ₹32.00 Cr. That is across 22,551 shows at 22.9% occupancy. Updated 05:53 pm IST, and still a live estimate rather than the final drop.
body:
Through Day 13 the desk has Ramayana at ₹849.3 Cr India nett, ₹981.1 Cr India gross, ₹502.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,483.1 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹820.95 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Worldwide is ₹16.90 Cr short of ₹1,500.0 Cr. Behind it on the daily chart, Scene at ₹2.90 Cr and Donga Naa Koduku at ₹0.80 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. The desk figure remains ₹849.3 Cr India nett and ₹1,483.1 Cr worldwide. No producer-certified total is included.
